    "dbea0bc7: ;If no data validation and internal entry of type WP,\n;and a COMPUTED EXPRESSION exists, display \"(No Editing)\".",
    "f282445c: ;Read the user's response into X after the specified DTIME.\n;If timeout, set DTOUT=U and X=U.",
    "6ee5ffca: ;Quit the current execution level.",
    "bfc72de0: ;Kill the previous DQ element and increment DQ by 1.",

    "01815bc9: If X is \"@\", do D and go to Z^DIE2.",
    "da3baf32: If X is a space, DV contains \"d\", DV does not contain \"P\", and the user's DIE word processing context for DLB exists, set X to the value stored in that context. If DV does not contain \"D\" or \"S\", write \"  \" followed by X.",
    "1a9651ad: Go to M^DIE17 if DV is true, go to ^DIE3 if DV contains \"V\", go to P if DV does not contain \"S\". If the DD field for DP,DIFLD has executable help, execute it. Set % to the portion of DU after the \":\" concatenated with X. If % is non-null and the DIC(\"S\") input transform exists, execute it. If no DB(DQ) node exists, write \"  \" followed by %. Go to V.",
    "dadb9cf0: Loop through each \":\" piece of DU. Set Y to the piece, DG to the position of \":\" concatenated with X within Y. Go to X if Y is null. Set YS to Y, then set Y to the portion before the first \":\". If DG is true and the DIC(\"S\") input transform exists, execute it. Quit the loop if DG is true.",
    "d1562937: If no DB(DQ) node exists, write the portion of YS from position DG to the end. Set X to the portion of YS before the first \":\".",
    "ce2191f3: If DV contains \"P\", set DIC to U_DU, DIC(0) to \"EN\" or \"NM\" based on whether DB(DQ) exists and whether DV contains \"'\". If DIC(0) contains \"L\", set DLAYGO to the second piece of DV after \"P\". If DV does not contain \"*\", do ^DIC. Set X to +Y, DIC to DIE. Go to X if X<0.",
    "cab74a87: If DV does not contain \"N\", do D. If the length of the portion of X after the decimal point is greater than 24, kill X and go to Z.",
    "5fccbf13: If the second piece of DV after \",\" is true, X contains \".\", and the 5th piece of DQ(DQ) after \"U\" does not contain \"$\", set X to X with leading zeros removed if X starts with \"00\", or trailing 0 removed if the last character of X is 0. If the portion of X after the decimal point is null and X contains \".\", set X to +X.",
